warnings.headline: Gale, yellow level, Maaloey - Stad, 2026-10-30T13:00:00+00:00, 2026-10-31T23:00:00+00:00
warnings.description: From Friday evening southerly near gale force 7, at times gale force 8. Saturday evening decreasing.
warnings.instruction: Do not go out in a small boat: High risk of dangerous situations when in a small boat at sea. Do not go out in a small boat: High risk of dangerous situations when in a small boat at sea. If the engine stops you can float towards land.
